metadata.description: Red tiles form three grain ears with paired kernels and a tied stalk. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Open constellation surround the motif, with broken crescents along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 8 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
